description: Issue #1178: the shared corpus for the plan contract's code rules R1-R8 (docs/contracts/advisor-plan.json) and the brief contract's code rules B1-B2 (docs/contracts/engagement-brief.json), whose descriptions define them. @clossys/advisor and @clossys/launcher each implement the rules separately and are both tested against every case here, so they judge every plan and brief the same way. Each case lists every violation expected, as its rule id and the position of the field at fault; an empty list means the document is accepted. Rule "schema" marks a refusal by the contract's keywords, and the code rules run only once those pass. Every expectation was written by hand from the rule text and re-derived by a separate Python reading of the rules, independent of either package, before the file was committed.
